_comment: Chapter 3 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): the scholar at home (hub_scholar): the Godborn (sets up chapter 4). S6 (docs/gameplay/23 §8): "How are things?" changes with the story (news_*: the latest chapter done).

text.zh_TW: 學者：「啊，里歐。要聽聽『神裔』的故事嗎？」
text.en: Scholar: "Ah, Leo. Shall I tell you about the Godborn?"

text.zh_TW: 學者：「傳說中，神裔能吸收被自己打倒之物的力量。他們幫人類擋住了古神……然後消失了。最後一個神裔的下落，連書上都沒寫。」他看著你的手。「……直到現在。」
text.en: Scholar: "Legend says the Godborn could take in the power of whatever they defeated. They held back the old gods for mankind... and then vanished. Not even the books say where the last one went." He looks at your hands. "...Until now."

text.zh_TW: 學者：「名冊的筆跡，我一頁一頁比對過了。寫字的人，手一直在抖。」
text.en: Scholar: "I've compared the ledger's handwriting page by page. The hand that wrote it was shaking the whole time."

text.zh_TW: 學者：「神裔的記載，我在舊書裡找到了三行。三行！整個王國都忘了他們。」
text.en: Scholar: "I found three lines about the Godborn in the old books. Three lines! The whole kingdom forgot them."

text.zh_TW: 學者：「安穩之星……原來是一道鎖。我要寫一本新的歷史，第一章就寫你。」
text.en: Scholar: "The Star of Peace... a lock, all along. I'm going to write a new history, and its first chapter is about you."
